single.why: There is one right answer and it is usually the most probable continuation. Sampling only adds ways to be wrong; beam search helps when the best answer needs a less likely first token.
single.examples: translation, extraction, classification, structured output, arithmetic

open.use: nucleus (top-p 0.8-0.95) with temperature 0.7-1.0; add a repetition penalty if loops appear
open.why: You want variety without nonsense. Temperature controls how adventurous the sampler is; top-p cuts the long tail of absurd tokens and adapts to how sure the model is. Greedy and beam loop or go bland here.
